notes.title: Chief Emoji Officer 1.1 update, release notes
notes.content:
CEO 1.1 is here! We made a couple updates to improve replayability in addition to bug fixes. Thanks for playing!

- Adds an option to speed up any dialogue that has already been seen on previously played chapters.
- Moves layoffs to end of chapters rather than the beginning of the next chapter.
- Unity update which should fix occasional crashing.
- A tiny bugfix to actually make your Pant job title "CEO" at the end (whoops!)
- A few dialogue fixes
